security.unobserved_warn: Some targets have not been observed. An empty backlog passes every policy: their verdict says nothing until a scan has succeeded.

compliance.controls_desc: Continuous evaluation against technical security controls and evidence retention

frameworks.eu_cra_desc: EU Digital Products Security & 24h CSIRT Notification
frameworks.soc2_desc: AICPA Trust Services Criteria — Security & Audit Integrity

history.title: History
history.subtitle: What each scan observed, on which version, and what was decided about it.
history.no_decisions_recorded: No triage decision has been recorded for this target — either nothing has been triaged, or the decisions predate the recording of this history.
history.no_issues_observed: No issue observed by this scan.

inventory.title: Component search
inventory.subtitle: Which of our projects ship a library, in which version — and in which release of ours.
inventory.search_help: The name matches loosely, on the component or its package URL. The version, when given, matches exactly — 2.14.1 is not 2.14.10.
inventory.truncated_warn: More occurrences than can be shown — narrow the search by version.
inventory.no_results: No project ships this component in that version.

owasp.title: OWASP report
owasp.subtitle: A Top 10 (2021) posture report written by the configured model, from what the scanners found.
owasp.analysis_privacy_note: The findings are sent to the model — their identifiers, severities and file paths. The source code is not. The report is a document: nothing in it becomes an issue, and nothing in it reaches a gate.
owasp.model_writing_notice: The model is writing. A local model takes tens of seconds on a backlog of this size.
owasp.no_findings: No findings categorized under this section.

quality.title: Quality
quality.subtitle: What source analysis reports about how the code is written, rather than about how safe it is.
quality.quality_notice: These findings never fail a build. They are visible, exportable, and have no say in the continuous-integration gate.

rule_sets.title: Semgrep rule sets
rule_sets.subtitle: Vectispire ships one rule; the public sets are not redistributable, so source-code coverage comes from a set you install here. What you upload travels with every scan, including to remote agents.
rule_sets.yaml_hint: YAML only. A folder is walked whole and everything that is not a rule file is left behind — said below, never in silence. Nothing is sent until you upload.
rule_sets.ignored_files: file(s) without a .yaml or .yml extension were ignored.
rule_sets.no_rules_found: No rule was found in the selected files.
rule_sets.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this rule set?

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: What Vectispire looks at, what it keeps, and what it announces.
settings.token_placeholder: Leave empty to keep it unchanged
settings.token_hint: Encrypted at rest, like an SSH key: it grants write access to the tracker, which is another class of secret than a URL. It cannot be shown again — saving an empty value erases it.
settings.siem_enable_desc: Forward high-priority security incidents (secret leaks, KEV, SLA breaches, gate failures) in ArcSight CEF v0.1 format.
settings.siem_endpoint_hint: Must point to a trusted internal or public SIEM collector.
settings.siem_auth_placeholder: Bearer <token> or Splunk <hec_token> (leave empty to keep current)
settings.threat_intel_title: Live Threat Intelligence Feed (CISA KEV & EPSS)
settings.threat_intel_desc: Continuous ingestion of active exploitation catalogues (CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities) and EPSS exploit probability scores. Reclassifies dormant backlog issues into urgent P0 incidents as soon as active attacks are observed in the wild.
settings.ai_provider_ollama: Ollama — a model on a host you run

ssh_keys.title: SSH keys
ssh_keys.subtitle: The deployment keys used to clone private repositories.
ssh_keys.generation_notice: Generating a pair from the interface is not ported yet. Generate one with ssh-keygen -t ed25519, then paste the private half here.
ssh_keys.name: Name
ssh_keys.private_key_hint: Encrypted with AES-256-GCM before writing to the database, under ENCRYPTION_KEY. The clear key is never stored and never returned over this API.
ssh_keys.public_key_hint: Optional, but recommended: it allows Vectispire to display the key's fingerprint without having to decrypt its private half.
ssh_keys.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this key? Repositories using it will fail to clone on their next scan.

encryption_status.current_hint: Encrypted with the current encryption key.
encryption_status.previous_key_hint: Encrypted with a previous encryption key. Save it again to move it under ENCRYPTION_KEY — and if it dates from the default key published in the repository, its private half is public: generate a new pair.
encryption_status.unreadable_hint: No configured key decrypts this value: the next clone that needs it will fail. Add the previous key to VECTISPIRE_PREVIOUS_ENCRYPTION_KEYS, or replace this SSH key.

agents.title: Agent Control Center & Scan Queue
agents.subtitle: Real-time supervision of execution daemons, running scans, and pending workload.
agents.unroutable_notice: scan(s) require the label, which no enabled agent carries. They will wait until somebody declares it.
agents.labels_hint: Comma-separated. A target naming a label will be dispatched only to an agent that carries it.
agents.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete this agent?
agents.token_modal_desc: Provide this bootstrap token to the remote agent daemon. It will not be shown again.
agents.running_subtitle: Scan tasks currently assigned and progressing on execution agents.
agents.pending_subtitle: Scheduled or on-demand scans waiting for an available compatible agent.
agents.no_pending: Queue is empty — all targets are up-to-date.

credentials_modes.local_hint: The agent uses its own git credentials. Vectispire sends it no key.
credentials_modes.delegated_hint: Vectispire sends the repository deployment key. Requires an encrypted link — the agent is refused otherwise.

api_keys.title: API keys
api_keys.subtitle: The keys that authenticate automated calls.
api_keys.name: Name
api_keys.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to revoke this API key?
api_keys.token_modal_desc: Save this token now. For security reasons, it cannot be viewed again.

scopes_list.scan_hint: Queue a scan on an existing target.
scopes_list.agent_hint: Claim and run scans. This scope executes code: grant it only to an agent.

users.title: User Management
users.subtitle: Manage user accounts, RBAC roles and permissions.

teams.title: Teams & Target Assignment
teams.subtitle: Group monitored targets and delegate visibility by team.

audit_log.title: Immutable Audit Log
audit_log.subtitle: Cryptographically chained ledger of all security modifications and operations.

gate_policies.title: Quality Gate Policies
gate_policies.subtitle: Define rules that determine whether a build or scan passes or fails.

severity_rules.none: No severity rule — actively exploited only

schedule.interval_hint: Counted from the end of the last scheduled round, so it drifts: use a cron expression when the hour matters.
schedule.cron_hint: Five fields — minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week. 0 2 * * * is every day at 02:00, 0 */6 * * * every six hours. The server refuses an expression it cannot read, so a mistake here is reported rather than saved.
schedule.cron_wins: Both are set, so the cron expression is what runs. The interval stays on the target and takes over again if the expression is cleared.
schedule.manual_only: Both are empty: this target is scanned only when somebody asks. There is no default schedule.

mfa.backup_codes_desc: Save these single-use recovery codes in a secure password manager. They allow you to sign in if you lose your authenticator device.
